Music GM: Treat smartlinks.json as the canonical SmartLink registry.
Route all SmartLink changes through the correct employee lane.
Do not allow alternate or duplicate public SmartLinks without Steve approval.
Track SmartLink status in Atlas/RJP/Status Board.
Submission Specialist: After a song/release is live, capture and verify its exact direct DSP or Ditto SmartLink.
Write verified live destinations back to Atlas/RJP and notify Music GM.
Digital Media & Channel Growth: Use the canonical collection SmartLink in posts, descriptions, blogs, profiles, QR destinations, and channel promotion where appropriate.
Do not substitute raw DSP links when the SmartLink is the intended campaign destination.
Track clicks and downstream performance where analytics are available.
Marketing Strategy & Analytics: Use canonical SmartLinks in campaigns and free-distribution research.
Keep the music offer primary and savings layer supplemental.
Do not alter the core 20-city campaign.
Research and rank free placement opportunities only after SmartLinks are verified live.
Video Production: Use the canonical SmartLink in video descriptions or handoff metadata when Digital Media requests it.
Do not create alternate campaign links.

global_rules: Direct links only. No search-result links.
Savings access remains free and no-obligation.
Savings offers are rotating and must be re-verified before public promotion.
If an offer expires or materially changes, replace it rather than leaving a dead offer.
SmartLink public URLs should remain permanent while destinations behind them may be updated.
Any external publish/spend/account action remains approval-gated.
Final approved SmartLink assets and evidence must be saved back to the central Sirocco Mesa release filing system.

migration.effective_rule: Custom Sirocco Mesa SmartLinks are the primary public links. Ditto SmartLinks remain backend reference/fallback only.

social profile bios and link fields

migration_rules: Replace old public Ditto SmartLinks with the appropriate custom Sirocco Mesa SmartLink anywhere the placement is editable.
Do not delete Ditto SmartLinks from backend evidence or release records; relabel them as backend reference/fallback.
Do not break existing QR codes that already point to the permanent Sirocco Mesa GitHub Pages hub; update the destination page behind them instead.
Where a historical third-party placement cannot be edited, record it as UNEDITABLE LEGACY and leave evidence.
Verify every changed public link by opening it after publication.
Do not mark migration complete until a second-pass audit finds no editable legacy Ditto SmartLinks.
